No readable VIN/engine number, no visible model badge, and no clear identification of which exact engine/gearbox is being offered.

claims.claim: Toyota Corolla 2010 engine and gear box 2ZR
claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show any readable engine/gearbox code, label, or casting/plate that confirms 2ZR or that it matches Corolla 2010.

risks.risk: Wrong engine/gearbox variant (2ZR vs another 2ZR-FE/2ZR-FBE or different Toyota family) or mismatched pairing.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of the engine block engine code/number (stamped/plate) and the gearbox code plate/label (or stamped code) with the numbers readable.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used Toyota engine + gearbox with unknown exact code (worst-case fitment risk), not as confirmed 2ZR.

risks.risk: Unknown condition (may be incomplete, damaged, or not running). Plastic wrapping hides missing parts and internal damage.
risks.proof: Video clip of a start/test (if available) OR photos of all components laid out with completeness checklist (starter, alternator, intake/exhaust manifolds, sensors, wiring/ECU if included).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven/untested and potentially incomplete (worst-case: needs overhaul).

risks.risk: Compatibility with buyer’s Corolla (mounts, starter position, wiring/ECU, transmission type: CVT vs manual/AT).
risks.proof: Ask for the buyer’s exact chassis/engine code (or provide seller’s compatibility statement backed by photos of the gearbox type label and ECU/wiring connectors).
risks.if_unproven: Price as requiring verification and possible additional parts for conversion (worst-case: extra cost).

risks.risk: Shipping/handling damage or missing accessories due to multiple units shown.
risks.proof: Photo of the exact unit being sold with a tag/label showing which engine/gearbox it is (and matching code numbers), plus close-ups of key interfaces (bellhousing mating surface, oil pan, timing cover area).
risks.if_unproven: Price as one of several similar units with no guarantee it’s the one you’ll receive (worst-case: treat as higher risk).

proof_requests: Send clear close-up photos of the engine code/number stamped on the block (readable) and the gearbox code plate/label (readable).
Send a short video showing the exact engine/gearbox being offered (pointing to the code numbers) and any test/start if available.
Confirm transmission type (manual/auto/CVT) and provide photos of the gearbox label.
Provide a parts completeness list (what is included: ECU, starter, alternator, sensors, wiring harness, mounts, etc.) with photos.
response.reason: The photo shows wrapped engines/gearboxes but nothing readable to confirm the exact 2ZR engine/gearbox or their condition. Without the code/label and completeness/test proof, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
